name: codex-shunt
description: Route high-volume, predictable Codex work to a subscription-authenticated Luna worker and measure the result.

interface.shortDescription: Route bulk work to Luna and measure usage.
interface.longDescription: Codex Shunt keeps judgment-heavy work in the primary model while routing large reads and predictable analysis to a subscription-authenticated GPT-5.6 Luna worker. It records local, content-free telemetry and produces CLI, JSON, CSV, and HTML reports.
defaultPrompt: Use Codex Shunt to inspect this repository.
Show my Codex Shunt usage statistics.
Summarize this large test log with Codex Shunt.
